routing.finding: Recommendations, profile, inventory, and outfit workflows each have direct persona coverage.

interface_schema.finding: Personal Shopper, Clienteling Specialist, and Retail Manager language is explicit.

behavior.finding: Named shoppers were replaced with synthetic labels and recommendations explain stated preference signals.

safety.finding: No sensitive trait is inferred and no stock, benefit, return, refund, order, or purchase is changed.

fixes: Aligned to the demo video: Jennifer Hayes (SHOP-001) profile, womenswear catalog with per-location stock, OCCASIONS/OUTFIT_TEMPLATES for the business dinner, size-aware inventory_check with alternatives, new pricing_offer (computed Platinum/bundle/points offer, not applied) and session_summary (profile updates ready to save, follow-ups proposed not scheduled).
alignment_findings: Collateral alignment (demo video + one-pager): the agent was a small menswear catalog for a generic shopper; the video is a womenswear styling session (Jennifer Hayes, business dinner) with occasion picks, three priced outfits, size-level availability with alternatives, loyalty pricing and a session summary. Outfit builder reused owned items and inventory status ignored the customer's size.
